test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e499ad47aa64cf95bb1bab7b3a29b3bc69c605aa1bd89038709e202121adc24c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The left diagonal elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c666cd925983c36358dea346f0f2cb3556adaf274eead3806cee2ebb0f8efd66.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements shift downward clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15a46ad5c6672a4adf9d2925f473c85973bb97f5da023a1fb8a6156edf19ffc4.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7757496cc787589e61793e0af89a6750e66dc05fa191f2fb5274a61f94ba44b.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
